sandbox.title: Your Trading Environment, Managed by CornGrid.
sandbox.description: CornGrid Sandbox is a managed MetaTrader 5 execution environment operated through CornGrid Infrastructure. Each sandbox enables automated strategies to run through an assigned MT5 terminal without requiring users to manually install and maintain their trading terminals.
sandbox.limit: Current separation uses individual terminal folders and processes on a node. It is not full VM isolation and does not provide a dedicated IP per sandbox. Availability depends on node capacity and subscription eligibility.

risk.description: CornGrid is a technology infrastructure platform, not a forex broker. CornGrid does not guarantee investment returns. Automated trading carries financial risk, including loss of capital. Strategy decisions and broker requirements remain the user’s responsibility.
privacy.title: How connection information is handled
privacy.description: Use the dashboard form over HTTPS for MT5 details. The backend stores sandbox credentials encrypted with AES-256-GCM and restricts access through account and administrator authentication. Authorized agents require connection details to run MT5; terminal configuration files on the node also contain those details. Folder separation is not a guarantee of complete security. Contact support@corngrid.com with privacy questions; this is a technical explanation, not a comprehensive privacy policy.
step.0.title: Subscribe
step.0.description: Choose an available plan. Access follows the existing payment and approval workflow.
step.1.title: Connect your MT5 account
step.1.description: Enter your broker server, MT5 account number and trading password through the HTTPS form. Sandbox credentials are encrypted in the database.
step.2.title: Select a strategy
step.2.description: Choose CornGrid EA and a supported pair. Partner strategies require administrator approval before becoming available.
step.3.title: Provision the sandbox
step.3.description: The backend validates subscriptions, allocates a node, assigns an MT5 terminal, deploys the EA and preset, and monitors connectivity.
step.4.title: Activate manually
step.4.description: Press Activate in the dashboard Sandbox menu. Once the environment is ready and MT5 connected, the strategy runs according to its rules and market conditions.

faq.0.title: What is CornGrid Infrastructure?
faq.0.description: A technology platform for managing supported MT5 execution environments, subscriptions, strategies and sandboxes from one dashboard.
faq.1.title: What is a CornGrid Sandbox?
faq.1.description: An assigned MT5 terminal with separate folders and processes on a CornGrid node. It is not a full VM and does not necessarily have a unique IP.
faq.2.title: Do I need my own VPS?
faq.2.description: Not for the supported hosted workflow. CornGrid manages the execution node, subject to available capacity.
faq.3.title: Do I need to install MetaTrader 5?
faq.3.description: Not on your own computer for the managed sandbox. You may still use your broker’s terminal to check your account.
faq.4.title: Can I connect my existing broker account?
faq.4.description: Yes, if the account, MT5 server and broker symbols are compatible. Connections must comply with your broker’s terms; contact support if unsure.
faq.5.title: Can I use multiple MT5 accounts?
faq.5.description: The dashboard supports multiple linked accounts within plan activation limits. Current provisioning allocates one sandbox per user; this differs from the account activation limit.
faq.6.title: What strategies are available?
faq.6.description: CornGrid EA is the primary strategy. Partner strategies are available only when approved and published by administrators.
faq.7.title: Is CornGrid a forex broker?
faq.7.description: No. CornGrid provides technology infrastructure. Accounts, market pricing and order execution are handled by your chosen broker.
faq.8.title: Does CornGrid guarantee trading profits?
faq.8.description: No. Automated trading can cause losses, including loss of capital. Past performance does not guarantee future results.
faq.9.title: How does the subscription system work?
faq.9.description: Sign in to view current plans. Select a plan, pay via DuitNow and submit proof for administrator review. Access follows approval and the plan’s validity period.
faq.10.title: Can developers publish their own Expert Advisors?
faq.10.description: Developers can apply as partners. After approval, submit EA details, files and supported presets. Publishing requires administrator review and approval.
faq.11.title: How are my MT5 credentials protected?
faq.11.description: Details are submitted over HTTPS and sandbox credentials are encrypted with AES-256-GCM in the database. Authorized agents use them to prepare MT5; node terminal configuration contains connection details. See the privacy information below for the limits of these controls.
